oneLiner: It collects your supplier invoices from their portals, so you never log in to download a PDF again.

pitch.need: lose an hour a month downloading invoices
pitch.benefit: signs in to each portal and brings every new invoice back
pitch.alternative: you log in to eleven portals and still forget two PDFs
pitch.difference: you say "fetch my invoices" and the list fills itself

moment.text: Say "fetch my invoices" and watch the agent click through the portal.
